headline: Comfort Systems Slides Despite Net Profit Expansion and Record Order Backlog
summary: Shares of mechanical and electrical contractor Comfort Systems declined despite the company delivering net profit growth and achieving a record order backlog.
why: Comfort Systems provides heating, ventilation, and electrical contracting services in the US, benefiting from commercial buildouts and industrial reshoring projects.

impacts.name: Comfort Systems USA Inc
impacts.why: Shares dropped as elevated investor expectations outweighed bottom-line growth and record backlogs.
